xpChart.legend: Solid dots joined by the line: maps no other map beats on both XP and profit. Hollow dots: maps another map beats on both.

simulationResults.title: Simulation Results
simulationResults.previousSkillOutOfMana: A previous skill was out of mana
simulationResults.heldByTriggerOverlap: Share of the whole simulation time each reason kept the skill from casting while it was ready; reasons can overlap, so they do not add up.

whatIf.title: What-if

goal.profit: Party profit per day, after tax

whatIf.choicesNote: Copied from the page when this window opens (a player unchecked on the page is unchecked here); changes here affect only this search.
whatIf.exportBad: not a character export: not kept

equip.name: Equipment
equip.desc: enhance each worn item, or buy another item for its slot

consumables.name: Food and drinks
consumables.desc: find the best foods and the best drinks first (every slot of each), then measure everything else on top of them

pairs.name: Food and drink pairs
pairs.desc: no longer needed: the food and drink search already tries whole combinations of every slot

owned.name: Items you own
owned.desc: swap in items from your inventory (needs the exporter's inventory)

abilities.name: Abilities
abilities.desc: swap in abilities you have learned (needs the exporter's learned abilities)

order.name: Ability order
order.desc: try every order of ability slots 2 to 5

triggers.name: Triggers
triggers.desc: tune the numbers and conditions of ability and consumable triggers

houses.name: House rooms
houses.desc: raise a combat house room, costed in its materials and coin

abilitylevels.name: Ability levels
abilitylevels.desc: raise an equipped ability with books; the cost can be an upper bound (≤)

books.name: New abilities
books.desc: learn an ability you do not have into an open slot (needs the exporter's learned abilities)

skills.name: Skill levels
skills.desc: raise a combat skill level, the days to reach it counted in coin

whatIf.noPlayers: Tick at least one player to simulate.
whatIf.badBudget: The budget for {{player}} is not a number of coin.
whatIf.noLevers: Tick at least one thing to search.
whatIf.sameNames: Two players have the same name; rename one tab first.
whatIf.alreadyRunning: A search is already running; showing it.
whatIf.runnerGone: The runner does not answer. Is it still running?
whatIf.pricesFailed: No search started: the market prices could not be fetched ({{error}}). Try again.
whatIf.missingPlayer: Nothing applied: no player tab is named {{names}}.
whatIf.applied: Applied to the setup. Run a simulation to see it.

progress.partSteps: Greedy steps: up to {{n}}, stops when none helps
progress.partMoreSteps: More greedy steps: up to {{n}} more
progress.partConfirmationWaiting: Confirmation: only if a step is accepted

result.baseLoses: At this zone the party loses money at base, so a gain here means losing less.
result.noSteps: No change gains beyond its error within the budgets.
result.playerLine: {{player}}: gain {{gain}} ± {{se}} per day, pays back in {{payback}} days
result.oldSplit: Saved before the per-player gain lines: run the search again to see them.
result.confirmedParty: Confirmed on fresh runs, party gain (the shared loot, before anyone's food and drink)
result.gainLegend: Party gain: the change in the group's shared loot per player per day, before anyone's food and drink. Buyer's gain: that player's share of it plus the change in what they spend on their own food and drink, so a free change can show no party gain and still pay the player by saving food and drink.
result.playerSplitSaved: {{loot}} loot share + {{amount}} food and drink saved
result.playerSplitMore: {{loot}} loot share - {{amount}} more food and drink bought
result.playerLineNoChange: {{player}}: gain {{gain}} per day, pays back in {{payback}} days
result.bestGain: party gain {{party}}, buyer's gain {{buyer}} per day
result.bestBaseline: Everything below is measured on top of these foods and drinks.
result.singlesNote: (against the setup the search started from; grey = not a clear gain for both the party and the buyer)
result.overBudgetNote: ({{n}}, not ranked: each is priced above its player's budget)
result.dominated: {{n}} swaps skipped (no better on any stat)
result.pricesSnapshot: Prices: market snapshot of {{when}} ({{elapsed}} old when shown).
result.pricesCommitted: Prices: the simulator's own saved snapshot of {{when}} ({{elapsed}} old), not the market of now.
result.upperNote: ≤: the cost is only an upper bound (ability books without the experience already inside the level).

col.partyGainTip: How much more the group's shared loot is worth per day per player with this change, before anyone's own food and drink.
col.buyerGainTip: How much more the player who pays for this change makes per day, after their own food and drink are paid. Payback is the cost divided by this.
